evidence.title: Building an LLM safe design system | Polar

name: Building an LLM safe design system
summary: Polar's essay on Orbit, a design system built so LLM-written UI can't drift: tokens as the only vocabulary, enforced in CI.
description: A blog post describing Polar's Orbit design system and the bet behind it: make off-brand decisions close to impossible to express in code. Covers why raw Tailwind class strings fail when an LLM is typing, treating classes as decisions instead of values, enforcing tokens in CI rather than docs, banning the bare <div> and handling dark mode.
contains: case for making tokens the only vocabulary in LLM-written UI
CI as the contract instead of docs
why raw Tailwind class strings drift off-system
banning the bare <div>; dark mode the LLM can't forget
